page.layout: One column of lexicon entries, Latin and Hebrew, on one printed page. Top left: page number. Top centre: Hebrew head word. No margin notes. Bottom right: Hebrew catchword.

main_text.p: שָׁלַט Dominari, Dominium exercere, Dominium habere : Hiphil הִשְׁלִיט Dominari fecit.
יִשְׁלַט Chal. idem. שְׁלַטּ Dominati sunt: Dominabitur. Ex Aphel וַיַּשְׁרְטָךְ Et dominatorem constituat te. Dan.2 38.
שַׁלִּיטָא m. Chald. idem, item, Facultatem habens: plur. שַׁלִּיטִין.
שִׁלְטָן m. Dominium, Dominatus : וּשְׁלְטָנָה Et dominatus ejus, Dan. 6. 26. שִׁלְטָנְהוֹן Dominatus eorum, Dan.7.12: Plur. שִׁלְטָנַיָּא, Dominatus, Dan.7.27.
שָׁלַךְ Hiphil הִשְׁלִיךְ Jecit, Abjecit, Projecit. Hophal הָשְׁלַךְ Abjectus fuit:
שָׁלַל Spoliare, Prædari, Depredari. Hithpahel הִשְׁתּוֹלֵל In prædam dedere se, Præda exponi. Hebræi ad animum transferunt, pro Mente spoliatum esse, Vesanum habere.

page.notes: The Hebrew vocalisation and some Chaldee forms are hard to read at this scan resolution; several Hebrew words are copied from the visible shapes and may contain small vowel errors. The Hebrew head word at the top centre is partly cut off. The bottom right Hebrew word is treated as a catchword.
